items.title: Brasília (DF) Supplies & equipment procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Nov 19 #90002
items.en_title: Brasília (DF) Supplies & equipment procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Nov 19 #90002
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Brasília (DF) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through electronic competitive bidding (concorrência), with an estimated value of about R$ 344,858,359.20; proposals close Nov 19, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
